result.reason: The additions substantively provide six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, a machine-readable data return within 30 days, and certified deletion. However, the clause’s operative chapeau remains limited to termination, so merely referring to “termination or expiration” in subparts (v) and (vi) does not clearly impose these duties upon expiry. The amendment is otherwise targeted and preserves the existing commercial intent, though the numbering and conjunctions should also be cleaned up for professional drafting.
